input.task: Design a comprehensive project management plan for developing an autonomous AI research laboratory. The project involves: (1) Establishing 5 specialized research teams, (2) Creating shared infrastructure for 15 different AI models, (3) Implementing real-time collaboration systems, (4) Setting up automated experimentation pipelines, (5) Managing a 2-year timeline with quarterly deliverables, (6) Coordinating with 8 external partner organizations, and (7) Handling budget allocation across multiple funding sources. Include risk mitigation, resource optimization, and adaptive timeline management.
